summary: Modern databases and data platforms increasingly embed AI/ML capabilities directly where data lives, eliminating costly data movement for inference, embeddings, and retrieval. Capabilities range from in-database ML model training (BigQuery ML, Redshift ML, Aurora ML) to managed LLM functions (Snowflake Cortex, Databricks Mosaic AI) and native or extension-based vector search for RAG and semantic retrieval. With Gartner projecting that 30% of enterprises will rely on vector-based retrieval for GenAI by 2026 and the vector database market forecast to reach ~USD 17.91 billion by 2034, native vector and LLM integration has become a core differentiator.

databases.name: Snowflake (Cortex AI)
databases.ai_feature: Snowflake Cortex AI — managed LLM and ML functions
databases.description: Cortex provides serverless SQL and Python functions for LLM tasks (COMPLETE, SUMMARIZE, TRANSLATE, SENTIMENT, EXTRACT_ANSWER), plus Cortex Search for retrieval, Cortex Analyst for natural-language-to-SQL, and embedding generation. It is also exposed to Snowflake Postgres so developers can call Cortex AI functions against Postgres-managed data.
databases.vector_search_notes: Native. Snowflake supports a VECTOR data type with VECTOR_COSINE_SIMILARITY / VECTOR_L2_DISTANCE functions and the fully managed Cortex Search service for hybrid semantic + keyword retrieval.
databases.llm_integration: Built-in access to hosted LLMs (e.g., Anthropic Claude, Meta Llama, Mistral, Snowflake Arctic) via Cortex functions; no external API wiring required.
databases.pricing_notes: Consumption-based: Cortex LLM functions billed per token/credit, embedding and search services billed by credits/serving compute on top of standard Snowflake warehouse and storage costs.

databases.name: Google BigQuery (BigQuery ML + Vertex AI)
databases.ai_feature: BigQuery ML with Vertex AI and Gemini integration
databases.description: BigQuery ML lets analysts create, train, and run ML models (regression, classification, clustering, time series, boosted trees, DNNs) directly with SQL, and call remote Vertex AI / Gemini models via ML.GENERATE_TEXT, ML.GENERATE_EMBEDDING, and AI generative functions for text generation, embeddings, and multimodal inference.
databases.vector_search_notes: Native. BigQuery supports VECTOR_SEARCH with vector indexes (IVF/TreeAH) and the ML.DISTANCE / ML.GENERATE_EMBEDDING functions for in-warehouse semantic search.
databases.llm_integration: Deep integration with Vertex AI and Gemini foundation models accessed through remote model objects and SQL AI functions.
databases.pricing_notes: BigQuery on-demand (per TB scanned) or capacity/slot-based pricing; Vertex AI / generative model calls billed separately per token or prediction.

databases.name: PostgreSQL (pgvector + pgai)
databases.ai_feature: pgvector embeddings storage plus pgai for in-database AI workflows
databases.description: pgvector adds a vector data type and similarity operators to Postgres, while pgai (and pgvectorscale/Timescale) brings embedding generation and LLM calls directly into SQL, letting Postgres act as a retrieval and RAG backend alongside relational data.
databases.vector_search_notes: Via extension. Vector search in Postgres is provided by the open-source pgvector extension (HNSW and IVFFlat indexes), not by core Postgres; capability depends on the extension being installed/enabled.
databases.llm_integration: pgai enables calling external LLM/embedding providers (OpenAI, Ollama, Cohere, etc.) from SQL to generate embeddings and completions; widely paired with LangChain for RAG.
databases.pricing_notes: Open source and free; cost is driven by the hosting infrastructure or managed Postgres service plus any external LLM/embedding API usage.

databases.name: Amazon Aurora ML
databases.ai_feature: Aurora Machine Learning — SQL-based inference via SageMaker and Bedrock
databases.description: Aurora ML lets you invoke ML models and foundation models from SQL, integrating Aurora (MySQL/PostgreSQL-compatible) with Amazon SageMaker, Amazon Comprehend, and Amazon Bedrock to run predictions and generate embeddings/text without exporting data.
databases.vector_search_notes: Not native to Aurora ML itself. Vector search on Aurora PostgreSQL is only available through the third-party pgvector extension; Aurora ML provides inference integration, not a built-in vector engine.
databases.llm_integration: Integrates with Amazon Bedrock (and SageMaker/Comprehend) for foundation-model text generation and embeddings callable from SQL.
databases.pricing_notes: Standard Aurora instance/storage/I/O pricing; separate charges for invoked SageMaker endpoints, Comprehend, or Bedrock model usage.

databases.name: Amazon Redshift ML
databases.ai_feature: Redshift ML — in-warehouse model training and inference with SQL
databases.description: Redshift ML uses SQL (CREATE MODEL) to train, deploy, and run models via Amazon SageMaker Autopilot and supports BYOM, plus integration with Amazon Bedrock for generative AI and LLM functions directly against warehouse data.
databases.vector_search_notes: Not natively supported as a full vector engine in classic Redshift ML; Redshift has added limited vector/embedding support, but dedicated native vector search is not a core Redshift ML feature, so retrieval typically relies on external services or OpenSearch.
databases.llm_integration: Integrates with Amazon Bedrock and SageMaker to invoke LLMs and generate predictions/embeddings from SQL.
databases.pricing_notes: Redshift node/RPU (serverless) pricing plus SageMaker training/inference and Bedrock usage charges for ML and generative functions.

databases.name: Databricks (Mosaic AI + Vector Search)
databases.ai_feature: Mosaic AI platform with managed Vector Search
databases.description: Mosaic AI provides end-to-end GenAI tooling — model serving, fine-tuning, foundation model APIs, agent frameworks, and RAG — on the lakehouse, with Mosaic AI Vector Search delivering a fully managed, governed vector index synced to Delta tables via Unity Catalog.
databases.vector_search_notes: Native. Databricks Mosaic AI Vector Search is a built-in managed vector database that automatically indexes and syncs embeddings from Delta tables.
databases.llm_integration: Foundation Model APIs and model serving give access to hosted and custom LLMs (Llama, DBRX, external providers), with agent and RAG frameworks built in.
databases.pricing_notes: Consumption-based DBUs for compute, model serving, and vector search endpoints plus underlying cloud storage; foundation model APIs billed per token or provisioned throughput.

databases.name: MongoDB Atlas Vector Search
databases.ai_feature: Atlas Vector Search for semantic and hybrid retrieval
databases.description: Atlas Vector Search stores embeddings alongside operational JSON documents and performs approximate nearest-neighbor search within the same database, enabling RAG and semantic search over live application data with aggregation-pipeline integration.
databases.vector_search_notes: Native. Vector search is built into MongoDB Atlas via the $vectorSearch aggregation stage and dedicated vector search indexes (HNSW-based), no external extension required.
databases.llm_integration: Not a built-in LLM provider; integrates with external models (OpenAI, Bedrock, Vertex, Hugging Face) and frameworks like LangChain/LlamaIndex to generate embeddings and power RAG.
databases.pricing_notes: Included within Atlas cluster pricing; dedicated Search Nodes can be provisioned separately for vector workloads, billed by node size and usage.
